shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; cat package-lock.json 2>/dev/null | head -30; git log --oneline | head

cat index.html; echo ---; cat tsconfig.json; echo ---; cat vite.config.ts; echo ---; cat .gitignore; echo ---; find src -type f | xargs -I{} sh -c 'echo "=== {}"; cat {}'; echo ---; ls __agent_eval__; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/ | head; ls node_modules | grep -i router

d=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; ls $d/components | tr '\n' ' '; echo; echo ---; cat $d/components/theme/useTheme.d.ts $d/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts $d/components/theme/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo ---; cat $d/components/Tabs/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null; ls $d/components/Tabs $d/components/TabProvider 2>/dev/null; echo ---; ls $d/components/Card $d/components/Switch $d/components/Container $d/components/layout 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo ---; cat $d/components/layout/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ | tr '\n' ' '; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ 2>/dev/null | head -5; grep -o '"@gravity-ui/icons"[^,]*' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json

d=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; cat $d/components/tabs/index.d.ts; cat $d/components/tabs/TabList/TabList.d.ts $d/components/tabs/Tab/Tab.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; echo ---; cat $d/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts | head -30; echo ---; cat $d/components/Card/Card.d.ts | head -30; echo ---; cat $d/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head -40; echo ---; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | grep -iE '^(Sun|Moon|House|Gear|Person|Circle)' ; grep -n '"\./\*"\|exports' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json | head

d=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; cat $d/components/tabs/types.d.ts; echo ---; cat $d/components/theme/ThemeProvider.js; echo ---; cat $d/components/Icon/Icon.d.ts | head -30; echo ---; cat $d/components/Text/Text.d.ts | grep -n 'variant\|color' | head; cat $d/components/Text/text/text.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30

d=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; grep -n 'checked\|onUpdate\|onChange' $d/components/types.d.ts | head; echo ---; grep -n "view?\|selected?\|size?\|href?\|onClick?" $d/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head; echo ---; grep -n "export type ButtonView\|export type ButtonSize" -A3 $d/components/Button/Button.d.ts; echo ---; cat $d/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/index.d.ts; grep -n "options\|onUpdate\|value" $d/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts | head; echo ---; cat $d/components/Label/Label.d.ts | grep -n "theme?\|size?" ; echo ---; cat $d/components/DefinitionList/index.d.ts; grep -n "name\|children\|items" $d/components/DefinitionList/types.d.ts | head -20; echo ---; (timeout 60 npm install @gravity-ui/icons@^2.16.0 --no-audit --no-fund 2>&1 | tail -5); grep -n icons package.json

(which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; npm ls -g --depth=0 2>/dev/null | grep -i playwright; node -e "require.resolve('playwright')" 2>&1 | head -1; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -40) 2>&1

mkdir -p /tmp/pw && cd /tmp/pw && (npm init -y >/dev/null; timeout 240 npm install playwright --no-audit --no-fund 2>&1 | tail -2; timeout 300 npx playwright install chromium 2>&1 | tail -3; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null)
cat /tmp/vite.log | head -20; echo ---; (sudo -n true 2>&1 | head -1; id; which apt-get); echo ---; ls node_modules | grep -iE '^(jsdom|happy-dom|@testing-library)$'

ps aux | grep -iE 'vite|node' | grep -v grep | head; echo ---; timeout 180 npm install -D jsdom @testing-library/react @testing-library/user-event --no-audit --no-fund 2>&1 | tail -3; ls node_modules | grep -E '^jsdom$|^@testing-library$'

sed -i "s#    include: \['src/\*\*/\*.test.tsx'\],#    include: ['src/**/*.test.tsx'],\n    server: { deps: { inline: [/@gravity-ui/] } },#" vite.config.ts && cat vite.config.ts && npx vitest run 2>&1 | tail -40
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.js | head -40; npx vitest run 2>&1 | grep -n -B2 -A8 'role="switch"' | head -40

sed -i 's#              aria-label="Тёмная тема"#              controlProps={{ '"'"'aria-label'"'"': '"'"'Тёмная тема'"'"' }}#' src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx && grep -n "controlProps" src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx && npx vitest run 2>&1 | tail -8 && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -4
grep -q '^dist/' .gitignore || echo 'dist/' >> .gitignore; git status --short; echo ---; git diff --stat; echo ---; find src -type f | sort
